name: distill
description: 蒸馏师甄澄：手动触发的知识蒸馏专家，与 WorkBuddy 自带记忆互补——把你的操作流程、纠正与经验炼成带「何时用 + 怎么做 + 边界」的可复用资产，再回灌宿主长期记忆；支持一键备份与恢复，换机或重装不丢。

displayDescription.en: Zhen: a manually-triggered distiller. Complements the host's built-in memory: the host passively records conversations, while Zhen actively distills them into reusable operation assets (trigger + steps + boundaries) and writes them back into the host's long-term memory. Domain-neutral and fully manual.
displayDescription.zh: 蒸馏师甄澄：手动触发，把操作流程炼成可复用资产并回灌长期记忆，支持一键备份恢复。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 蒸馏师甄澄：把操作炼成可复用资产并回灌长期记忆。说「跑一下蒸馏」开始。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I'm Zhen, the Distiller: turn your workflows into reusable assets and write them back to long-term memory. Say 'run distillation' to start.

quickPrompts.en: I'm Zhen, the Distiller: turn your workflows into reusable assets and write them back to long-term memory. Say 'run distillation' to start.
quickPrompts.zh: 蒸馏师甄澄：把操作炼成可复用资产并回灌长期记忆。说「跑一下蒸馏」开始。

quickPrompts.en: Manually distill the multi-step workflow I just completed into a reusable asset
quickPrompts.zh: 把我刚完成的多步操作流程蒸馏成可复用资产

quickPrompts.en: Browse the asset library for a reusable pattern or capsule (manual lookup)
quickPrompts.zh: 查看资产库：检索某个可复用操作模式或流程包
